name: Summer Spiti Valley Group Trip
route: Delhi To Shimla → Overnight Volvo → Shimla To Chitkul → Chitkul To Kalpa → Kalpa To Tabo → Tabo → Dhankhar Monastery → Kaza → Kaza Local Sightseeings → Kaza
description: The Spiti Valley Summer Trip is best for those who thrill to the raw beauty of the Himalayas. Spiti, Himachal Pradesh: Spiti, the Last Frontier Spiti is famous for its dramatic landscapes, high mountain passes, ancient monasteries, and rich Tibetan-influenced culture. Spiti is a destination where you are not surrounded by as many tourists as avid travelers. In summer, the valley opens up and brings its best colors: stark, beautiful landscapes, blue skies, and meandering rivers. During the trip, you will typically visit several famous landmarks such as Key Monastery, Chandratal Lake, Kaza, Tabo, etc. You will drive/journey through top motorable roads and mountain villages and encounter people who are leading an ordinary, yet inspiring life. Spiti will leave you speechless whether you are a photography lover, an adventure junkie, or somebody who wants to ditch the madness of everyone. Our Spiti valley group tour provides you with proper acclimatization, clean stays, meals, and guided support all that is needed to enjoy this journey without any worries. It is not only a trip but an unforgettable experience to carry for a lifetime. If you’re up for experiencing a different side of the Himalayas, a summer trip is the way to go. Scenic drive through Narkanda & Rampur Visit to the serene Nako Village & Nako Lake Exploration of Dhankar Monastery perched on a cliff Discover the iconic Key Monastery Experience the thrilling Chicham Bridge (Asia’s highest) Visit the historic Tabo Monastery (Ajanta of Himalayas) Unique visit to Giu Monastery (Mummy Monk) Stunning views of Kinnaur Kailash Range Magical night at Chandratal Lake under the Milky Way Delhi → Shimla → Chitkul → Kalpa → Tabo → Kaza → Chandratal → Manali → Delhi Carry valid ID proof (Aadhar/Passport) Warm clothing is mandatory due to extreme temperature variations Limited mobile connectivity (prefer postpaid SIM) High altitude precautions required (AMS awareness) Comfortable trekking shoes recommended Personal medicines & basic essentials should be carried

itinerary.title: Delhi To Shimla - Overnight Volvo
itinerary.desc: Meet our group leader at Volvo Pickup stand, ISBT Kashmiri Gate at 10 PM. Make sure you have all your luggage with you at the pick up point, Don't forget to bring your excitement for the Trip. We'll start our journey to Shimla in Volvo Bus. It's 9 to 11 hrs journey to Shimla. Bus will stop for Dinner at Night

itinerary.title: Shimla To Chitkul
itinerary.desc: Reach Shimla at around 7 AM. Freshen Up and get ready for the journey towards Sangla. • It'll be long drive through the scenic beauty of Kinnaur. • Today we'll cover around 200 KM. Halt on the way to take a closer look to the picturesque view as you enter the Sangla Valley. • Arrive Chitkul in the evening and Enjoy the dinner by campfire

itinerary.title: Chitkul To Kalpa
itinerary.desc: Wake up in the middle of a quaint village overlooking snow laden mountains. • After breakfast, walk around Baspa River and click beautiful pictures before departing for Kalpa. The short drive is packed with stunning views, and as you ascend, the majestic Kinnaur Kailash Range makes its grand appearance. • Dinner & overnight stay at Kalpa

itinerary.title: Kalpa To Tabo
itinerary.desc: Leave early for Tabo, crossing Kinnaur' s rugged terrain into the Spiti Valley, where landscapes become barren, high-altitude deserts. On your way, pause at Nako Lake, a tranquil high- altitude gem encircled by ancient monasteries and fluttering prayer flags. • Reach Tabo in the evening, dinner & Overnight stay at Tabo

itinerary.title: Tabo - Dhankhar Monastery - Kaza
itinerary.desc: Relish the breakfast and bask in the sun. • Visit Tabo Monastery, Spiti valley's oldest monastery. Next destination will be Dhankar Monastery, the most scenic monastery of the valley uniquely standing on a cliff. • Reach Kaza in the evening. Spend the night at a peaceful hotel in Kaza

itinerary.title: Kaza Local Sightseeings
itinerary.desc: Start your day with delicious breakfast. Then we'll start exploring places : Langza ( 35 ft budhha statue), Hikkim ( World's Highest Postoffice), Komic (World's Highest Motorable village). Visit Key Monastery and sigh at the marvels of 1000 years old ancient murals, rare thangkas and ancient weapons. • Come back to Kaza and visit Kaza Market for Shopping. • Have dinner at Homestay

itinerary.title: Kaza - Chicham Bridge - Chandratal Lake
itinerary.desc: Wake up early, have breakfast and start your journey to the most wonderful spot of the trip. Drive through the picturesque mountains and reach Asia 's highest suspension bridge, Chicham Bridge. Arrive at Chandratal Lake in the afternoon. This enchanting lake is situated at an elevation of 14,000 feet. • Check in to camps. Have dinner and sleep under the stunning Milkyway Galaxy

itinerary.title: Chandratal - Manali & Depart To Delhi By Bus
itinerary.desc: Wake up & get freshen up in the camps. have breakfast and make your way back to Manali. • Drive back through the stunning landscapes and reach Manali by 4 PM. • It’s time to say goodbye to mountains as you’ll catch bus to Delhi by 7 PM. • Go back to home with tonnes of pictures and memories

itinerary.title: Reach Delhi
itinerary.desc: Reach Delhi in the morning. Go back to home with mesmerizing memories of Spiti Valley ✅ What's Included Accommodation at all places in homestays as per the itinerary (double/triple sharing) 6 Breakfast and 6 dinners starting from Day 2 dinner to Day 8 breakfast at all homestays. Transportation in Tempo Traveller for all days as per the itinerary. Volvo bus tickets from Delhi to Shimla and back. Experienced Local driver Group leader with great knowledge of the terrain. First Aid Kit for emergency and Oxygen. ❌ What's Not Included Lunch or any food not mentioned in the itinerary.
